description: Find this week's promotions (Aktionen) at Swiss supermarkets: Coop, Migros, Lidl, Aldi, Denner, Aligro, Volg and Otto's. Search by product (any language; German/French/Italian names match best), filter by store and category. Returns at most 20 deals, biggest discount first, with price, regular price, discount and last day (null = while stocks last). A multi-buy offer (Coop's 'ab 2 Stück') adds a condition; its price is for one piece. Switzerland only, prices in CHF.

category.description: produce (fruit & veg), protein (meat & fish), dairy (incl. eggs), pantry, frozen, beverage.

language.description: Language for product names and labels (Aligro and Volg are not shown for 'it').

query.description: Product to look for, e.g. 'Poulet', 'chicken', 'Kaffee', 'mozzarella'. Leave empty for the biggest discounts overall.

retailers.description: Only these stores. Leave empty for all.

name: eini_search_deals
title: Search Swiss supermarket deals
